leah-marketing: Quick sync — want to finalize the SDR pocket-rebut cards for cloud vendors before Monday. Focus: latency/cost + rollout reliability. Short bullets only. @maria-sdr can you run one-liner objections? :memo:
jamal-prod: +1. We should include a 'fallback guarantees' line — customers care about fallbacks. Suggest: "Auto-fallback to compatible model variants when capacity hits SLO breach" — is that too technical?
maria-sdr: I'll draft 6 quick responses. Top objections we've heard: 'managed APIs cheaper', 'we host already', 'can't trust latency at scale'.
olivia-growth: For webinar headline test, can we A/B 'Predictable inference at cloud price' vs 'Production-ready inference without the ops tax'?
sam-eng: FYI: bench slide 6 numbers updated — 95th/p99 tail improved after batching change. I can drop a tiny chart. Code snippet for benchmarking call:
```
curl -X POST https://bench.redwood/api/run -d '{"model":"x", "seq":512}'
```
bench-bot: benchmark run #372 completed — median latency 64ms, p95 112ms, p99 198ms
leah-marketing: Perfect. Maria, keep replies <=2 sentences. Jamal, can you confirm the fallback wording is acceptable/legal?
jamal-prod: PRD: fallback described as 'automatic model variant routing' — safe. Avoid 'smarter' claims. Legal flagged 'unlimited uptime' before.
maria-sdr: Drafts:
- 'We're not cheaper on list price, but spend-efficient at scale with batching + KV caching.'
- 'If you already host, we make your inference predictable and shippable across regions.'
- 'Fallback: automatic routing to compatible variants to preserve SLOs.'
leah-marketing: Love them. Olivia — pick the webinar headline and we'll pair with bench chart. Also need routing triggers: 2x time-on-task or failed model call -> send to enterprise SDR queue.
olivia-growth: Going with 'Production-ready inference without the ops tax' — more punch. Will update landing copy.
leah-marketing: Action items: Maria — finalize 6 replies by EOD. Jamal — confirm final legal-safe phrasing. Sam — export p95/p99 PNGs. Olivia — update headline & landing. I'll assemble pocket PDF for SDRs. :rocket:
maria-sdr: On it. :thumbsup:
